I wanted to make something different for you.

A quiet little place made only for you, so whenever the world feels heavy, you can come back here and remember how deeply you are loved. Every line belongs to you. Every word was written with you in my heart.

–

Reasons I love you

A few of so many.

Moments I keep replaying

Small seconds that feel bigger because they remind me of you.

Little things I want you to read on hard days

Tiny letters, to keep.

“You make my life softer.”
“Even simple moments feel special with you.”
“You are one of the most beautiful parts of my life.”
“If happiness had a face, it would look a lot like yours.”
“I love the version of me that exists around you.”
“Somehow, my heart feels most at home with you.”

How we became us

The feeling

When you became more than just someone

I don’t know exactly when it happened, but one day my heart started choosing you quietly.

The truth

I started finding you in everything

In random songs, in silent moments, in little thoughts I never told anyone.

The distance

Loving you from far away was never enough

I wanted to be closer, not just in words, but in your life, in your days, in your heart.

The ask

So let me love you properly

Not as someone temporary, but as someone who wants to stay, care, and choose you every day.

A little secret, just for you

Open the envelope. I left something inside.

click to open

and now, finally

What my heart has been trying to say.

I’m not great with grand speeches. I’d rather show it in a hundred small ways: a saved seat, a remembered detail, a hand reaching for yours without thinking.

But if I had to put it into one line…

I really, truly love you, Tahia.

I don’t want to love you from a distance anymore. I want to be the person who gets to choose you, care for you, and stay beside you. Would you let me love you a little closer, a little louder, and a lot more honestly?

If you ever let someone stay close to your heart, I hope it can be me.

Made with love, just for you.

Dear Tahia,

Happy Birthday, Tahia! 🎂 Today is all about you, and I hope it’s filled with smiles, sweet things, and everything that makes your heart happy.

Thank you for being you. You make my days brighter just by being in them, and I’m so grateful to have you in my life.

I wish you endless happiness, lots of laughter, and every dream coming true this year and always.

And I love you, so so much. More than I can say, and more than this little page can hold. ♥

Always yours,
